params.name: resellerCompanyId
params.description: Reseller company ID. This field is required if you do not include the Customer company ID

params.name: customerCompanyId
params.description: Customer company ID. This field is required if you do not include the Reseller company ID

params.name: searchText
params.description: Search term used to search on different fields of the customer company association.

params.name: createdOn
params.description: Date filter, defined by upper or lower inclusive or exclusive limits, in Unix timestamp format. Acceptable values are: gte([timestamp]) - 'greater than or equal to'; or lte([timestamp]) - 'less than or equal to'

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort field and order. For ascending sort order, use the '+[FieldName]' format. For descending order, use the '-[FieldName]' format.

items.docs: Retrieves all customer company associations. This request requires either the Reseller company ID or the Customer company ID, which you can retrieve with the [List companies](#list-companies) request.
Creates an association (link) between a customer company and a reseller company.
